neet_phy_u11_t03_3.working: Each charge gives E = 9e9 × 4e-6 / (0.1)^2 = 3.6e6 N/C. Both fields point toward the negative charge, so they add: 7.2e6 N/C toward the negative charge.

neet_phy_u11_t03_4.working: Lines never cross because the field has one direction at each point (A-II). Crowded lines mean a strong field (B-IV). Lines meet a conductor's surface at right angles (C-III). A uniform field has parallel, equally spaced lines (D-I).

neet_phy_u11_t03_5.working: A is false: electrostatic field lines do not form closed loops. B is true. C is true. D is true: motion is like a projectile, so the path is parabolic. E is false: the field inside a conductor in equilibrium is zero. Correct set is B, C, D.
